statements.venue: House Intelligence Committee press release (statement as chairman)
statements.quote: Frontier labs may soon achieve self-improving AI, and the U.S. must reach this threshold first to secure economic and national security dominance and potentially enjoy an enduring advantage over our adversaries.

statements.reason: Treats self-improving AI as a goal the US should reach first in the race with China; no catastrophic risk is acknowledged (ruling 5: competition with China is D).

notes: Eight web searches ran, none refused. crawford.house.gov returned no results in the site-restricted search; his AI statements are on intelligence.house.gov (committee site).
